user.title: Noo-Psyche K7 lamp
user.description: The lamp must be in LAN mode (joined to your Wi-Fi). Setup only reads from the lamp.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the lamp. Check the IP, that port 8266 is reachable from Home Assistant, and that the lamp is in LAN mode.

abort.unsupported_model: This lamp looks like a K7 Mini. This integration currently supports the K7 Pro only.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Write a 24-slot schedule to the lamp (ALL_SET, auto mode, current local time). Skipped if the lamp already has it.

config_entry_id.name: Lamp
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when several K7 lamps are set up.

qr_payload.name: QR payload
qr_payload.description: Text from a Noo-Psyche app / bitbarista schedule QR code.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: 24 rows of [hour, minute, white, royal blue, green, UV, cyan, red].

manual.name: Manual levels
manual.description: 6 levels used in manual mode. Defaults to the QR code's or the lamp's current values.

align_day_start.name: Align to day start
align_day_start.description: Shift the schedule so its photoperiod starts at the 'Day starts at' hour set in the editor card.

sync_clock.name: Sync clock
sync_clock.description: Send Home Assistant's local time to the lamp.

config_entry_id.name: Lamp
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when several K7 lamps are set up.

start_acclimation.name: Start acclimation
start_acclimation.description: Ramp the lamp's schedule linearly from a start intensity to 100% over a number of days. The scaled schedule is written once a day shortly before lights-on. The target is the given profile or QR code, or the lamp's current schedule.

config_entry_id.name: Lamp
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when several K7 lamps are set up.

start_percent.name: Start intensity
start_percent.description: Intensity on day 0, as a percentage of the target schedule.

days.name: Duration
days.description: Days until the full schedule is reached.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Name of a saved profile to use as the target.

qr_payload.name: QR payload
qr_payload.description: A Noo-Psyche app schedule QR code to use as the target.

align_day_start.name: Align to day start
align_day_start.description: Shift the schedule so its photoperiod starts at the 'Day starts at' hour set in the editor card.

config_entry_id.name: Lamp
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when several K7 lamps are set up.

keep_current.name: Keep current intensity
keep_current.description: Keep today's reduced schedule instead of switching to the full target.

set_moonlight.name: Set moonlight
set_moonlight.description: Add night-time light that follows the real moon at Home Assistant's location: its brightness tracks the moon's illumination, and with 'Follow the moon' it's only on while the moon is above the horizon. The lamp gets a new 24-hour plan daily, shortly before lights-on.

config_entry_id.name: Lamp
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when several K7 lamps are set up.

max_level.name: Level at full moon
max_level.description: Lamp level (%) at full moon high in the sky.

follow_moon.name: Follow the moon
follow_moon.description: Only light while the moon is up, brightening as it rises. Off: phase-based level all night.

channels.name: Channels
channels.description: Channel index (0 White, 1 Royal Blue, 2 Green, 3 UV, 4 Cyan, 5 Red) to share of the moon level in %, e.g. {"1": 100, "4": 70}.
